title: Agent bundle manifest
description: Per-agent inventory of skills + templates shipped to customer's VPS at provision time. Validated by supabase/functions/_shared/manifest-validator.ts at provisioning + at test time (drift checks).

agent_slug.description: Folder slug — must match one of the 10 known PERSONA_SLUGS in soul-md-template.ts

version.description: Semver. Bumped when skills[] or templates[] change.

description_id.description: Bahasa Indonesia bundle description for catalog UI

items.comment: tier is deprecated (Phase 2E-2) — use enabled_for_tiers. Neither is required at the schema layer; validateManifest enforces the 'at least one present' cross-field invariant and translates legacy tier -> enabled_for_tiers.

skill_kind.description: Discriminates a single-shot skill ('skill', the default when absent) from a multi-step playbook ('playbook' — SKILL.md carries a ## Langkah-langkah section of ordered gated steps, driven by the flow-state state-machine engine).

template_fetch_required.description: P1 strict template-fetch flow (2026-05-22 consult). When true, the SKILL.md must carry a ## Fetch template section instructing the agent to consult its persona's template library before improvising. Enforced by tests/template-fetch-required-drift.spec.ts.

templates_used.description: Template ids (from this manifest's templates[]) the skill references

tier.description: DEPRECATED (Phase 2E-2). Legacy single-tier field; translated to enabled_for_tiers by validateManifest. Use enabled_for_tiers in new manifests.

enabled_for_tiers.description: Canonical tier eligibility. Bundle-pull filters skills by intersecting the customer's tier with this array.

kind.description: Free-form category label: invoice, contract, letter, fixture, schema-spec, etc.

source.description: bundled = shipped from agent-packs/; customer-grown = generated by extend-capabilities

generated_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp; only present when source=customer-grown

self_extend.description: True iff this agent's runtime can use the extend-capabilities skill to grow its library at runtime

extension_dir.description: Absolute path on the customer's VPS where customer-grown templates persist
